No finite search is presented as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural first-obstruction threshold and complete initial nontrivial obstruction taxonomy for an established NP-hard nonmonotone network game; the condition on vertex-disjoint cycles reveals a structural existence mechanism and the two small witnesses show exactly how shared-cycle vertices defeat it. The finite classification is mathematically motivated by the cycle-sharing boundary rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
